applicability.population: Narrative programming review with examples from several sports; no single intervention cohort or athlete-specific dose established.
applicability.intervention: Review of work/relief intensity and duration, modality, repetitions, series and between-series recovery, plus cardiopulmonary and non-cardiopulmonary loads.
applicability.comparator: Programming configurations discussed in a narrative review, not a direct trial of this TFCL recipe.
outcomes: Work/recovery configuration can alter acute physiological responses; cardiorespiratory response alone does not capture all loading.
limitations: No direct validation of 5–7×3 min, Z5 individual domain, 3-min recovery, final-rest occurrence, weekly frequency or VLamax-based restriction. Existing source restrictions remain unchanged.
Ne remplace pas vérification du temps à VO2 élevé, ni de l’adaptation chronique.

applicability.population: 20 cyclists; results about perceptions across tested positions, not an individual Ironman cohort tolerance certificate.
applicability.intervention: Three tests in randomized order, 45 min at 50% individual peak aerobic power, with different knee and trunk flexion combinations.
applicability.comparator: Different bicycle positions at the experimental workload, not 4×15 versus 6×10 min bouts.
outcomes: Perceptions of comfort, fatigue and pain varied across positions; upright trunk was more comfortable in the study's recreational context.
limitations: Study intensity is relative to peak aerobic power, not automatically Z2/FTP. No 15-min bout tolerance, recovery duration, aerodynamic gain or equivalence of interruptions is demonstrated.
Pas de garantie de tolérance aux 4x15 min aérodynamiques.
